snippet.title: BlenDead – Reveal Trailer | 16-Player Hide & Seek on Steam
snippet.description:
BlenDead is a 16-player online hide & seek game where Hiders disguise themselves as NPCs and Seekers have 10 bullets to find them. Shoot the wrong NPC and you lose ammo. Blend in. Don't get caught.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam

HOW IT WORKS
- Hiders blend into crowds of NPCs — walk, work, dance, act like one of them
- Seekers start with 10 bullets. Hitting a Hider is free, hitting an innocent NPC costs you one bullet.
- Get caught? You become a Seeker and hunt the rest
- 5 minute rounds, up to 16 players
- Risky tasks for Hiders, a Hot/Warm/Cold hint for Seekers, slaps that knock Seekers out, and a lobby arena where everyone can shoot everyone
- Maps: medieval market, nightclub, beach — more coming

Coming to Steam in 2026. Wishlist to get notified at launch.
